Content: Hi Jessica, I just wanted to say you did a great job at the Maple Avenue open house today. It’s always nice working together. Maybe we can grab dinner later this week and talk about what’s coming up for the team. Let me know what you think. —Elm
Hi Elm, Thanks for the note. I enjoyed working with you too. Dinner sounds good—how about Thursday after work? We can talk about Maple Avenue and catch up. Jessica
Thursday works for me. I’ll pick a spot and let you know. See you then, Jessica. —Elm
Looking forward to it. Have a good night, Elm. Jessica

Hello John, Thank you for reaching out to Elm & Ivy Properties. We’re delighted to assist you with your housing needs. If you have any questions about available listings or would like to schedule a viewing, please let us know. Best regards, The Elm & Ivy Properties Team info@elmivyproperties.com (590) 456-7890

Hi Alex, Thanks for your interest in the apartment on Maple Avenue. Are you available for a viewing this Thursday at 3 PM, or would another time work better for you? Please let us know your availability, and we’ll do our best to accommodate. Best regards, David Leasing Agent, Elm & Ivy Properties
Hi, I saw your listing for the apartment on Maple Avenue. Is it still available? If so, I'd like to know more details and possibly schedule a viewing. Thanks, Alex

Hi Alex, Thanks for reaching out about the Maple Avenue apartment. It's available right now. Are you free for a viewing this Thursday at 3 PM? If that doesn't work, just let me know what times are better for you. Happy to answer any questions you have about the place, too. Best, Jessica Lee Leasing Agent, Elm & Ivy Properties
Hi Jessica, Thursday at 3 PM works for me. Looking forward to seeing the apartment. Thanks, Alex
Great, Alex. You're all set for Thursday at 3 PM. If you think of any questions before then, just send me an email. See you soon. Best, Jessica
Hi, I'm a tenant at 120 Birch Street, Apt 2B. The heating isn’t working, and it’s getting pretty cold. Could someone take a look? Let me know if you need more info from me. Thanks, Emily

Hi Emily, Thanks for letting us know about the heating issue. Sorry you’re having trouble. Can you tell me if the thermostat is showing any error messages or if there are any unusual noises? Once I have a bit more detail, I’ll arrange for our technician to come by—most likely later today or tomorrow morning. Let me know what works best for you. Best, Carlos Ramos Maintenance Coordinator, Elm & Ivy Properties
Hi Carlos, The thermostat just says 'Low Battery,' and there’s a clicking noise when I try to turn up the heat. I’m home all day today, so anytime works. Thanks for the quick response! Emily

Thanks, Emily. That’s helpful. We’ll send our technician, Mike, over around 1 PM today. He’ll give you a call when he’s on his way. If anything changes or you need to reschedule, just reply here. Best, Carlos
Hi, I moved out of 88 Willow Lane last week and wanted to check on the status of my security deposit refund. Let me know if you need any additional info from me. Thanks, Laura

Hi Laura, Thanks for getting in touch. I've checked your file and the final inspection was completed yesterday with no issues reported. Your security deposit will be processed this Friday, and you'll receive a confirmation email once it's sent. If you have any questions in the meantime, just let me know. Best, Mark Patel Accounts Manager, Elm & Ivy Properties
Thanks for the update, Mark. I'll watch for the confirmation email. Appreciate your help! Laura
You're welcome, Laura! Happy to help. Have a great day. Best, Mark
Hi, I'm interested in the townhouse at 39 Cedar Court. Before I schedule a viewing, can you tell me what your pet policy is? I have a medium-sized dog. Thanks, Tom

Hi Tom, Thanks for reaching out about 39 Cedar Court. We do allow pets in that property, including dogs up to 50 pounds. There’s a $300 non-refundable pet fee and a monthly pet rent of $35. Let me know if you have any other questions or if you’d like to set up a tour. Best, Megan Walters Leasing Specialist, Elm & Ivy Properties
Thanks, Megan. That works for me. I’d like to schedule a viewing for Friday afternoon if possible. Tom
Hi Tom, Friday afternoon is open. How does 2:30 PM sound? Looking forward to meeting you and your dog. Best, Megan
